en_body:
## Overview

Google Pixel 9 is listed in our worldwide phone directory. Country or market recorded: not recorded. This is an evergreen reference guide, not a new launch or a claim that the institution or product was recently announced.

## Source-listed information

- **Model Version:** Pixel 9 (2024), base model, India connectivity
- **Market:** India
- **Processor:** Google Tensor G4; Titan M2
- **Ram:** 12 GB
- **Display:** 6.3-inch Actua OLED; 1080 × 2424; 60–120 Hz
- **Battery:** 4700 mAh typical
- **Charging:** Up to 27 W wired; charger sold separately
- **Rear Camera:** 50 MP wide + 48 MP ultrawide
- **Front Camera:** 10.5 MP autofocus
- **Dimensions:** 152.8 × 72 × 8.5 mm
- **Weight:** 198 g
- **Wifi:** Wi-Fi 6 in India
- **Bluetooth:** 5.3
- **Protection:** IP68
- **Operating System:** Launched with Android 14
- **Update Policy:** 7 years from first US Google Store availability
- **Storage Note:** Manufacturer lists 128/256 GB globally; availability varies by region and channel.
- **Scope Note:** Base Pixel 9 only; India Wi-Fi differs from global Wi-Fi 7. Old India product-spec URL now redirects to a newer generation.

## Verification and limitations

This profile is based on a source directory record. An empty field means the information was not verified, not that a feature or course is unavailable. Figures and specifications may change by country, variant and date. Always confirm on the [source page](https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/7158570?hl=en) before applying or buying. Published as a reference guide on 2026-11-02, not as breaking news.
